en: Sepia-toned image of a richly decorated Baroque church interior, focusing on a monumental pipe organ above the main entrance. The organ case is very tall and ornate, with multiple ranks of pipes framed by carved columns, putti and angels, and elaborate stucco decoration on the surrounding vault. Below it is a balcony with a balustrade over a large arched opening leading to a doorway at the back of the nave, flanked by wooden pews.
